name: Warp Current
author: E. T. Carter
description: A Warp variation: a whole warp of fine fibres combed into a flowing current. Hundreds of thin bright threads sweep across the frame, bent by a shared domain-warped flow so they gather and part like silk under water, taking palette hues by flow angle and bunching into luminous off-centre bands. Two parallaxing depth layers of fibre.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Master speed of the combing current that sweeps the fibres; 0 holds the weave nearly still.

params.label: Thread count
params.effect: Density of fibres across the frame, from a coarse banded weave to fine dense hair.

params.label: Swirl
params.effect: Strength of the flow warp that bends the threads; 0 leaves near-straight warp threads, high churns them into sweeping currents.

params.label: Near layer speed
params.effect: Flow speed of the bright foreground fibre layer relative to the master current; lets the near sheet race ahead of or lag the far one.

params.label: Far layer speed
params.effect: Flow speed of the dim background fibre layer; differing near and far speeds make the two sheets drift across each other for live parallax.

params.label: Thread width
params.effect: Thickness of each fibre core; low draws fine sharp hair, high swells the threads into soft broad ribbons.

params.label: Backdrop fill
params.effect: A flow-following colour wash that lifts the dark gaps between fibres; 0 keeps the deep near-black void, high floods the weave with a dim ambient current.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far the palette ranges with flow angle; 0 washes the whole current in one hue, high cycles many colours as the threads bend.

params.label: Hue shift
params.effect: Rotates which palette colours the flow angles map to, sliding the whole weave around the colour wheel.

params.label: Far layer tint
params.effect: How strongly the far fibre layer shifts toward a single palette anchor; high pushes the background a distinct colour for depth separation.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: Parallax separation between the two fibre sheets and how much the far one darkens; low flattens them together, high sinks the far sheet back into shadow.

params.label: Glow focus X
params.effect: Horizontal position of the luminous comb-band focus, sliding the brightest bunching of fibres left or right for an off-centre composition.

params.label: Glow focus Y
params.effect: Vertical position of the luminous comb-band focus, raising or lowering where the current glows brightest.
